Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?

Hi — yes, possibly. If it’s been less than 30 minutes since you placed the order, you can usually update it yourself through your confirmation email.

turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
llation window.

You can cancel an order within 1 hour of placing it.

In the first 45 minutes, you can usually cancel it yourself from your confirmation email using the “Edit or View your order” button.
If you’d rather, we can cancel it for you during that window too.
Between 45 minutes and 1 hour, we can still cancel it on our side.
After 1 hour, cancellation usually isn’t possible.

If you want help with a specific order, send me the order number and I’ll check it for you 🙂

What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?

Hi — once an order has already shipped, we can’t change the shipping address on our side. 🙂

If it’s going to the wrong address:

If you can retrieve it there, that’s the fastest option
If not, you can file a shipping claim at claims.simplemodern.com to have your products resent to the correct address

If you want me to check a specific order, send the order number.

How do I update my contact or account details?

Hi! You can update your contact and account details directly through your account on simplemodern.com.

Here's how:

Log in to your account at simplemodern.com
Go to your account settings
From there, you can update your email, password, and other account information

If you're having trouble accessing or updating anything yourself, let me know what you need to change and I can pass it along to the team to help you out! 😊

Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?

Hi Evan — we’re not able to combine two separate orders into one shipment once they’ve been placed. 💛

Because orders move through fulfillment quickly, each order is processed separately.

If one of the orders was just placed, you may still be able to edit or cancel it from your confirmation email during the self-service window. Otherwise, they’ll ship separately. 🙂

Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
